title: Alarm dialog gone after minimizing and maximizing the app
symptom: After an alarm was triggered, pressing the home button minimized the app. Upon maximizing, the audio alarm continued but the alarm dialog was gone, preventing the user from stopping the alarm. The user had to reboot the device to stop it.
evidence_quote: After maximizing the application the audio was still there but the alarm dialog was gone. So I couldn't stop the alarm. I had to reboot the device to get rid of it.
